title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 2 章‧伊瑪的地窖

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm,
ahura mazda mainyô
spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum kahmâi paoiryô mashyânãm
aperese-tûm ýô ahurô mazdå anyô
mana ýat zarathushtrâi,
kahmâi fradaêsayô daênãm
ýãm âhûirîm zarathushtrîm.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda:
O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker
of the material world, thou Holy One!
Who was the first mortal, before myself, Zarathushtra,
with whom thou, Ahura Mazda, didst
converse, whom thou didst teach the Religion of Ahura,
the Religion of Zarathushtra?
segments.zh:
查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊，最仁慈的善靈啊！
在我查拉圖斯特拉之前，誰是第一個凡人，你阿胡拉‧馬茲達與之交談，教他阿胡拉之教、查拉圖斯特拉之教的人？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýimâi
srîrâi hvãthwâi ashâum zarathushtra
ahmâi paoiryô mashyânãm
aperese azem ýô ahurô mazdå
anyô thwat ýat zarathushtrât,
ahmâi fradaêsaêm daênãm
ýãm âhûirîm zarathushtrîm.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered:
The fair Yima, the good shepherd, O holy Zarathushtra!
he was the first
mortal, before thee, Zarathushtra, with whom I, Ahura Mazda, did
converse, whom I taught the Religion of Ahura, the Religion of
Zarathushtra. 3. Unto him, O Zarathushtra, I, Ahura Mazda, spake,
saying: 'Well, fair Yima, son of Vivanghat, be thou the preacher
and the bearer of my Religion!' And the fair Yima, O Zarathushtra,
replied unto me, saying: 'I was not born, I was not taught to
be the preacher and the bearer of thy Religion.'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：
美好的伊瑪啊，善良的牧人啊，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！
他是第一個凡人，在你查拉圖斯特拉之前，我阿胡拉‧馬茲達與他交談，教他阿胡拉之教、查拉圖斯特拉之教的人。於是，查拉圖斯特拉啊，我阿胡拉‧馬茲達對他說，言道：『美好啊，伊瑪，維凡格的兒子，你當做我宗教的傳道者與承負者！』而美好的伊瑪啊，查拉圖斯特拉啊，回答我說：『我未曾出生，未曾被教導成為你宗教的傳道者與承負者。』

segments.orig:
âat hê mraot zarathushtra
azem ýô ahurô mazdå,
vîsangha mê ýima srîra vîvanghana
meretô beretaca daênayâi,
âat mê aêm paityaoxta
ýimô srîrô zarathushtra,
nôit dâtô ahmi nôit cistô
meretô beretaca daênayâi.

âat hê mraom zarathushtra
azem ýô ahurô mazdå,
ýezi mê ýima nôit vîvîse
meretô beretaca daênayâi âat mê
gaêthå frâdhaya âat mê gaêthå
varedhaya âat mê vîsâi gaêthanãm
thrâtâca haretâca aiwyâxshtaca.
segments.en:
Then I, Ahura Mazda, said thus unto him, O Zarathushtra: 'Since
thou dost not consent to be the preacher and the bearer of my
Religion, then make thou my world increase, make my world grow:
consent thou to nourish, to rule, and to watch over my world.'
segments.zh: 於是我阿胡拉‧馬茲達如此對他說，查拉圖斯特拉啊：『既然你不同意成為我宗教的傳道者與承負者，那麼你當使我的世界增長，使我的世界生息；你當同意去養育、統治並守護我的世界。』

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta
ýimô srîrô zarathushtra, azem tê
gaêthå frâdhayeni azem tê gaêthå
varedhayeni azem tê vîsâne gaêthanãm
thrâtâca haretâca aiwyâxshtaca, nôit
mana xshathre bvat aotô vâtô nôit garemô
nôit axtish nôit mahrkô.
segments.en:
And the fair Yima replied unto me, O Zarathushtra, saying:
'Yes! I will make thy world increase, I will make thy world grow.
Yes! I will nourish, and rule, and watch over thy world. There
shall be, while I am king, neither cold wind not hot wind, neither
disease nor death.'
segments.zh: 而美好的伊瑪回答我說，查拉圖斯特拉啊，言道：『是的！我將使你的世界增長，我將使你的世界生息。是的！我將養育、統治並守護你的世界。只要我為王，將沒有冷風也沒有熱風，沒有疾病也沒有死亡。』

segments.orig:
âat hê zaya frabarem
azem ýô ahurô mazdå suwrãm zaranaênîm
ashtrãmca zaranyô- paêsîm.
segments.en:
Then I, Ahura Mazda, brought two implements unto him: a
golden seal and a poniard inlaid with gold. Behold, here Yima
bears the royal sway!
segments.zh: 於是我阿胡拉‧馬茲達帶給他兩件工具：一枚金質的印璽與一把嵌金的短劍。看啊，伊瑪在此掌握王權！

segments.orig: ýimô asti berethe xshathrayå.
segments.en: [Obscure.]
segments.zh: 〔難以解讀。〕

segments.orig:
âat ýimâi xshathrâi thrisatô-zima
hañjaseñti,
âat hê îm zå bvat perene
pasvãmca staoranãmca
mashyânãmca sûnãmca vayãmca
âthrãmca suxrãm saociñtãm
nôit hîm gâtvô viñden
pasvasca staorâca mashyâca.
segments.en:
Thus, under the sway of Yima, three hundred winters passed
away, and the earth was replenished with flocks and herds, with
men and dogs and birds and with red blazing fires, and there was
room no more for flocks, herds, and men.
segments.zh: 如此，在伊瑪的統治下，三百個冬季逝去，大地充滿了羊群與牧畜、人與狗與鳥類和紅色熊熊燃燒的火焰，再沒有地方容納羊群、牧畜與人類。

segments.orig:
âat ýimâi paiti-vaêdhaêm,
ýima srîra vîvanghana
perene îm zå hañgata
pasvãmca staoranãmca
mashyânãmca sûnãmca vayãmca
âthrãmca suxrãm saociñtãm
nôit hîm gâtvô viñdeñti
pasvasca staorâca mashyâca.
segments.en:
Then I warned the fair Yima, saying: 'O fair Yima, son of Vivanghat,
the earth has become full of flocks and herds, of men and dogs
and birds and of red blazing fires, and there is room no more
for flocks, herds, and men.'
segments.zh: 於是我警告美好的伊瑪說：『美好的伊瑪啊，維凡格的兒子啊，大地已經充滿了羊群與牧畜、人與狗與鳥類和紅色熊熊燃燒的火焰，再沒有地方容納羊群、牧畜與人類。』

segments.orig:
âat ýimô frashûsat raocå â
upa rapithwãm hû paiti adhwanem,
hô imãm zãm aiwishvat
suwrya zaranaênya
avi dim sifat ashtraya uityaojanô,
fritha speñta ârmaite
fraca shva vîca nemangha barethre pasvãmca staoranãmca
mashyânãmca.
segments.en:
Then Yima stepped forward, in light, southwards,
on the way of the sun, and (afterwards) he
pressed the earth with the golden seal, and bored it
with the poniard, speaking thus: 'O Spenta Armaiti,
kindly open asunder and stretch thyself afar, to
bear flocks and herds and men.'
segments.zh:
然後，伊瑪向前踏出，在光明中，向南，
在太陽之路上，和（afterwards）他
用金印壓緊大地，並用它鑽孔
用匕首，這樣說：『斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提，
請敞開並伸展自己遠去，以
承載群羊、群畜和人們。』

segments.orig:
âat ýimô imãm zãm vîshâvayat
aêva thrishva ahmât masyehîm ýatha para
ahmât as, tem ithra fracareñta pasvasca staorâca
mashyâca
hvãm anu ushtîm zaoshemca
ýatha kathaca hê zaoshô.
segments.en:
And Yima made the earth grow larger by one-third than it was
before, and there came flocks and herds and men, at their will
and wish, as many as he wished.
segments.zh:
而且，伊瑪使大地增長了三分之一，超過它當時的大小
以前，並且有群羊、群畜和人們出現，按照他們的意願
和願望，數量正如他所希望的那樣。

segments.orig:
âat ýimâi xshathrâi xshvash-satô-zima
hañjaseñti, âat hê îm zå
bvat perene ... mashyânãmca.
segments.en:
Thus, under the sway of Yima, six hundred winters passed away,
and the earth was replenished with flocks and herds, with men
and dogs and birds and with red blazing fires, and there was room
no more for flocks, herds, and men.
And I warned the fair Yima, saying: 'O fair Yima, son of Vivanghat,
the earth has become full of flocks and herds, of men and dogs
and birds and of red blazing fires, and there is room no more
for flocks, herds, and men.'
Then Yima stepped forward, in light,
southwards, on the way of the sun, and (afterwards) he
pressed the earth with the golden seal, and bored it
with the poniard, speaking thus: 'O Spenta Armaiti, kindly)
open asunder and stretch thyself afar, to bear
flocks and herds and men.'
segments.zh:
是故，在伊瑪的統治下，六百個冬季逝去了，大地充滿了羊群和牲畜、人類和狗和鳥類以及紅色熊熊燃燒的火焰，再沒有空間容納羊群、牲畜和人類。
我警告美麗的伊瑪，說：『美麗的伊瑪啊，維瓦格哈特之子，大地已經充滿了羊群和牲畜、人類和狗和鳥類以及紅色熊熊燃燒的火焰，再沒有空間容納羊群、牲畜和人類。』
於是伊瑪踏步向前，在光明中，朝南方，沿著太陽之路，其後他用黃金印璽按壓大地，用短劍鑿穿它，說道：『斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提啊，請善意地裂開並伸張你自己，廣闊地展開，以承載羊群和牲畜和人類。』

segments.orig:
âat ýimô imãm zãm vîshâvayat
dva thrishva ahmât masyehîm ýatha para ahmât
as, tem ithra fracareñta pasvasca staorâca mashyâca
hvãm anu ushtîm zaoshemca ýatha kathaca hê
zaoshô.
segments.en:
And Yima made the earth grow larger by two-thirds than it
was before, and there came flocks and herds and men, at their
will and wish, as many as he wished.
segments.zh: 而且伊瑪使大地變大，比之前大三分之二，並且有羊群、牛群和人們，依照他們的意願和願望，數量正如他所希望的。

segments.orig:
âat ýimâi xshathrâi nava-satô-zima
hañjaseñti, âat hê îm zå
bvat perene pasvãmca staoranãmca mashyânãmca
sûnãmca vayãmca âthrãmca suxrãm
saociñtãm, nôit hîm gâtvô
viñden pasvasca staorâca mashyâca.
segments.en:
Thus, under the sway of Yima, nine
hundred winters passed away, and the earth was
replenished with flocks and herds, with men and
dogs and birds and with red blazing fires, and there was
room no more for flocks, herds, and men.
segments.zh: 因此，在伊瑪的統治下，九百個冬天過去了，大地補充了羊群、牛群、人類、狗、鳥類以及紅色的烈火，以至於不再有空間容納羊群、牛群和人類。

segments.orig:
âat ýimâi paiti-vaêdhaêm, ýima
srîra vîvanghana perene îm zå hañgata
pasvãmca staoranãmca mashyânãmca sûnãmca
vayãmca âthrãmca suxrãm saociñtãm,
nôit hîm gâtvô viñdeñti
pasvasca staorâca mashyâca.
segments.en:
And I warned the fair Yima, saying: 'O fair Yima, son of Vivanghat,
the earth has become full of flocks and herds, of men and dogs
and birds and of red blazing fires, and there is room no more
for flocks, herds, and men.'
segments.zh: 而且我警告美麗的伊瑪，說：'哦美麗的伊瑪，維凡加特之子，大地已經充滿羊群、牛群、人類、狗、鳥類以及紅色的烈火，且不再有空間容納羊群、牛群和人類。'

segments.orig:
âat ýimô frashûsat raocå â
upa rapithwãm hû paiti adhwanem, hô imãm
zãm aiwishvat suwrya zaranaênya avi dim sifat ashtraya
uityaojanô, fritha speñta ârmaite fraca shva
vîca nemangha barethre pasvãmca staoranãmca
mashyânãmca.
segments.en:
Then Yima stepped forward, in light, southwards, on the way
of the sun, and (afterwards) he pressed the earth with the golden
seal, and bored it with the poniard, speaking thus: 'O Spenta
Armaiti, kindly) open asunder and stretch thyself afar, to bear
flocks and herds and men.'
segments.zh: 然後伊瑪向前走，在光明中，向南，沿著太陽的道路，以及（之後）他用金印壓大地，用短刀鑽穿大地，如此說著：'哦斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提， kindly）請敞開並伸展自己遠去，以容納羊群、牛群和人類。'

segments.orig:
âat ýimô imãm zãm vîshâvayat
thribyô thrishvaêibyô ahmât masyehîm
ýatha para ahmât as, tem ithra fracareñta
pasvasca staorâca mashyâca hvãm anu ushtîm
zaoshemca ýatha kathaca hê zaoshô!
segments.en:
And Yima made the earth grow larger
by two-thirds than it was before, and there came
flocks and herds and men, at their will and wish,
as many as he wished.
segments.zh: 而且伊瑪使大地變大，比之前大三分之二，並且有羊群、牛群和人們，依照他們的意願和願望，數量正如他所希望的！

segments.orig:
hañjamanem frabarata ýô dadhvå ahurô
mazdå hathra mainyaoibyô ýazataêibyô
srûtô airyene vaêjahi vanghuyå dâityayå,
hañjamanem frabarata ýô ýimô
xshaêtô hvãthwô hathra vahishtaêibyô
mashyâkaêibyô srûtô airyene vaêjahi
vanghuyå dâityayå.
segments.en:
The Maker, Ahura Mazda, called together a meeting of the celestial
Yazatas in the Airyana Vaejo of high renown, by the Vanguhi Daitya.
The fair Yima, the good shepherd, called together
a meeting of the best of the mortals, in the Airyana
Vaejo of high renown, by the Vanguhi Daitya.
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，召集天界亞扎塔的會議，在名聲卓著的艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，在萬古希‧戴提亞河。美麗的伊瑪，善良的牧人，召集凡人中最優秀者的會議，在名聲卓著的艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，在萬古希‧戴提亞河。

segments.orig:
â-tat hañjamanem paiti-jasat ýô
dadhvå ahurô mazdå hathra mainyaoibyô
ýazataêibyô srûtô airyene vaêjahi
vanghuyå dâityayå, â-tat hañjamanem
paiti-jasât ýô ýimô xshaêtô
hvãthwô hathra vahishtaêibyô mashyâkaêibyô
srûtô airyene vaêjahi vanghuyå dâityayå.
segments.en:
To that meeting came Ahura Mazda, in the Airyana Vaejo of
high renown, by the Vanguhi Daitya; he came together with the
celestial Yazatas.
To that meeting came the fair Yima, the good shepherd, in the
Airyana Vaejo of high renown, by the Vanguhi Daitya; he came together
with the best of the mortals.
segments.zh: 該會議中來了阿胡拉‧馬茲達，在名聲卓著的艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，在萬古希‧戴提亞河；他與天界亞扎塔共聚。該會議中來了美麗的伊瑪，善良的牧人，在名聲卓著的艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，在萬古希‧戴提亞河；他與凡人中最優秀者共聚。

segments.orig:
âat aoxta ahurô mazdå ýimâi,
ýima srîra vîvanghana avi ahûm astvañtem
akhem zimô jangheñtu ýahmat haca staxrô
mrûrô zyå, avi ahûm astvañtem akhem
zimô jangheñtu ýahmat haca paurvô snaodhô
vafra snaêzhât barezishtaêibyô gairibyô
bãshnubyô areduyå.
segments.en:
And Ahura Mazda spake unto Yima, saying:
'O fair Yima, son of Vivanghat! Upon the material
world the evil winters are about to fall, that shall
bring the fierce, deadly frost; upon the material
world the evil winters are about to fall, that shall
make snow-flakes fall thick, even an aredvi deep on
the highest tops of mountains.
segments.zh: 而且阿胡拉‧馬茲達對伊瑪說話，說：'哦美麗的伊瑪，維凡加特之子！在物質世界上，邪惡的冬天即將來臨，那將帶來兇猛致命的霜凍；在物質世界上，邪惡的冬天即將來臨，那將使雪花厚厚落下，甚至在最高山頂上深達一個aredvi。'

segments.orig:
thrizhatca idha ýima gêush apa-jasat ýatca
anghat thwyãstemaêshu asanghãm ýatca
anghat bareshnush paiti gairinãm ýatca jãfnushva
raonãm paxrumaêshu nmânaêshu.
segments.en:
'And the beasts that live in the wilderness, and those
that live on the tops of the mountains, and those that live
in the bosom of the dale shall take shelter in underground
abodes.
segments.zh: 『而那些生活在荒野中的獸類，以及那些生活在山頂上的獸類，以及那些生活在山谷懷抱中的獸類，將會在地下的住所中尋求庇護。

segments.orig:
parô zimô aêtanghå
danghush anghat beretô vâstrem
tem âfsh paurva vazaidhyâi
pasca vîtaxti vafrahe abdaca idha ýima anguhe astvaite
sadayât ýat idha pasêush anumayehe padhem vaênâite.
segments.en:
'Before that winter, the country would bear plenty of grass
for cattle, before the waters had flooded it. Now after the melting
of the snow, O Yima, a place wherein the footprint of a sheep
may be seen will be a wonder in the world.
segments.zh: 『在那個冬季之前，這片土地會為牲畜生出豐富的草料，在水淹沒它之前。現在在雪融化之後，伊瑪啊，一個地方若能看見羊的腳印，那將是世上的奇蹟。

segments.orig:
âat tem varem kerenava caretu-drâjô kemcit
paiti cathrushanãm hathra taoxma upa-bara pasvãmca
staoranãmca mashyânãmca sûnãmca
vayãmca âthrãmca suxrãm saociñtãm,
âat tem varem kerenava caretu-drâjô kemcit paiti
cathrushanãm narãm aiwi-xshôithne caretu-drâjô
kemcit paiti cathrushanãm gavãm gâvayanem.
segments.en:
'Therefore make thee a Vara, long as a riding-ground on every
side of the square, and thither bring the seeds of sheep and
oxen, of men, of dogs, of birds, and of red blazing fires. Therefore
make thee a Vara, long as a riding-ground on every side of the
square, to be an abode for man; a Vara, long as a riding-ground
on every side of the square, for oxen and sheep.
segments.zh: 『因此你要為自己製造一個瓦拉，在四方上各邊都長如一個騎行場地，並把羊和牛、人、狗、鳥，以及紅色熊熊燃燒的火的種子帶到那裡。因此你要為自己製造一個瓦拉，在四方上各邊都長如一個騎行場地，用作人類的住所；一個瓦拉，在四方上各邊都長如一個騎行場地，用作牛和羊。

segments.orig:
hathra âpem frâtat-caya
hâthrô-masanghem adhwanem
hathra marekhå avastaya, avi mat zairi-gaonem mat hvairyeite
ajyamnem,
hathra nmânå avastaya katemca fraskembemca fravâremca
pairi-vâremca.
segments.en:
'There thou shalt make waters flow in a bed a hathra long;
there thou shalt settle birds, on the green that never fades,
with food that never fails. There thou shalt establish dwelling-places,
consisting of a house with a balcony, a courtyard, and as gallery.
segments.zh: 『你將在其中使水流成一條長度為一哈特拉的溝渠；你將在永不褪色的綠色之上安頓鳥類，有永不缺乏的食物。你將建立住居，由帶有陽台的房屋、庭院和廊道組成。

segments.orig:
hathra vîspanãm narãm nâirinãmca
taoxma upa-bara ýôi heñti ainghå zemô
mazishtaca vahishtaca sraêshtaca, hathra vîspanãm
gêush saredhanãm taoxma upa-bara ýôi
heñti ainghå zemô mazishtaca vahishtaca sraêshtaca.
segments.en:
'Thither thou shalt bring the seeds of men and women, of the
greatest, best, and finest on this earth; thither thou shalt bring
the seeds of every kind of cattle, of the greatest, best, and
finest on this earth.
segments.zh: 『你將把人和女人的種子帶到那裡，即這片土地上最偉大、最優秀、最精良的；你將把每一種牲畜的種子帶到那裡，即這片土地上最偉大、最優秀、最精良的。

segments.orig:
hathra vîspanãm urvaranãm taoxma upa-bara
ýôi heñti ainghå zemô barezishtaca
hubaoidhitemaca, hathra vîspanãm hvarethanãm
taoxma upa-bara ýôi heñti ainghå zemô
hvarezishtaca hubaoidhitemaca, tê kerenava mithwaire ajyamnem
vîspem â ahmât ýat aête narô
varefshva anghen.
segments.en:
'Thither thou shalt bring the seeds of every kind of tree,
of the highest of size and sweetest of odour on this earth;
thither thou shalt bring the seeds of every kind of fruit, the
best of savour and sweetest of odour. All those seeds shalt
thou bring, two of every kind, to be kept inexhaustible there,
so long as those men shall stay in the Vara.
segments.zh: 『你將把每一種樹木的種子帶到那裡，即這片土地上身形最高大、香氣最甘甜的；你將把每一種水果的種子帶到那裡，即風味最上乘、香氣最甘甜的。所有那些種子你應該帶去，每種各帶兩個，使其在那裡保持取之不盡，只要那些人留在瓦拉中。

segments.orig:
mâ athra frakavô mâ apakavô mâ
apâvayô mâ haredhish mâ driwish mâ
daiwish mâ kasvîsh mâ vîzbârish
mâ vîmîtô-dañtânô mâ
paêsô ýô vîteretô-tanush
mâdha-cim anyãm daxshtanãm ýôi
heñti angrahe mainyêush daxshtem mashyâishca
paiti nidhâtem.
segments.en:
'There shall be no humpbacked, none
bulged forward there; no impotent, no lunatic;
no malicious, no liar; no one spiteful, none jealous; no one with
decayed tooth, no leprous to be pent up, nor any of the brands
wherewith Angra Mainyu stamps the bodies of mortals.
segments.zh: 『在那裡將不會有駝背者，也不會有向前突出者；沒有陽痿者，沒有瘋癲者；沒有惡毒者，沒有說謊者；沒有人是怨恨者，沒有人是嫉妒者；沒有人牙齒腐爛，沒有麻風病患被關起來，也沒有任何安格拉‧曼紐在凡人身體上所刻下的標記。

segments.orig:
fratemem dainghêush nava perethwô kerenava madhemô
xshvash nitemô tishrô, fratemem perethwô hazangrem
narãm nâirinãmca taoxma upa-bara madhemô
xshvash sata nitemô tishrô sata, aiwica tê varefshva
suwrya zaranaênya
apica tem varem mareza dvarem raocanem hvâraoxshnem añtare-naêmât.
segments.en:
'In the largest part of the place thou
shalt make nine streets, six in the middle part, three
in the smallest. To the streets of the largest part
thou shalt bring a thousand seeds of men and
women; to the streets of the middle part, six hundred;
to the streets of the smallest part, three
hundred. That Vara thou shalt
seal up with thy golden seal, and thou shalt make a door, and
a window self-shining within.'
segments.zh: 『在這個地方最大的部分，你應該製造九條街道，在中間部分製造六條，在最小的部分製造三條。向最大部分的街道上你應該帶去一千個男人和女人的種子；向中間部分的街道上，六百個；向最小部分的街道上，三百個。那個瓦拉你應該用你的金色印章密封起來，你應該製造一道門，以及一扇在內部自我發光的窗戶。』

segments.orig:
âat mãsta ýimô, kutha tê
azem varem kerenavâne ýâ mê aoxta ahurô
mazdå, âat aoxta ahurô mazdå ýimâi,
ýima srîra vîvanghana ainghå zemô
pâshnâbya vîspara zastaêibya vîxadha
mãnayen ahe ýatha nû mashyâka xshivisti
zemê vîshâvayeiñte.
segments.en:
Then Yima said within himself: 'How shall I manage to make
that Vara which Ahura Mazda has commanded me to make?' And Ahura
Mazda said unto Yima: 'O fair Yima, son of Vivanghat! Crush the
earth with a stamp of thy heel, and then knead it with thy hands,
as the potter does when kneading the potter's clay.'
segments.zh: 那時伊瑪在心中說：『我如何才能製造出阿胡拉‧馬茲達命令我製造的那個瓦雷納呢？』阿胡拉‧馬茲達對伊瑪說：『美麗的伊瑪啊，維瓦格罕塔之子啊！用你的腳跟踏碎大地，然後用你的雙手揉搓它，就像陶匠揉搓陶土一樣。』

segments.orig:
âat ýimô avatha kerenaot ýatha dim
ishat ahurô mazdå ainghå zemô pâshnâbya
vîsparat zastaêibya vîxadhat mãnayen
ahe ýatha nû mashyâka xshivisti zemê
vîshâvayeiñte.
segments.en:
[And Yima did as Ahura Mazda wished; he crushed the earth
with a stamp of his heel, he kneaded it with his hands, as the
potter does when kneading the potter's clay.]
segments.zh: 〔伊瑪便如阿胡拉‧馬茲達所願而行；他用腳跟踏碎大地，用雙手揉搓它，就像陶匠揉搓陶土一樣。〕

segments.orig:
âat ýimô varem kerenaot caretu-drâjô
kemcit paiti cathrushanãm, hathra taoxma upa-barat pasvãmca
staoranãmca mashyânãmca sûnãmca
vayãmca âthrãmca suxrãm saociñtãm,
âat ýimô varem kerenaot caretu-drâjô
kemcit paiti cathrushanãm narãm aiwi-xshôithne
caretu-drâjô kemcit paiti cathrushanãm gavãm
gâvayanem.
segments.en:
And Yima made a Vara, long as a riding-ground on every side
of the square. There he brought the seeds of sheep and oxen, of
men, of dogs, of birds, and of red blazing fires. He made a Vara,
long as a riding-ground on every side of the square, to be an
abode for men; a Vara, long as a riding-ground on every side of
the square, for oxen and sheep.
segments.zh: 伊瑪製造了一個瓦雷納，四方形的每一邊都長如一個騎行場。他帶去了羊和牛的種子，人類的種子，狗的種子，鳥類的種子，以及紅色熾熱火焰的種子。他製造了一個瓦雷納，四方形的每一邊都長如一個騎行場，作為人類的居所；又製造了一個瓦雷納，四方形的每一邊都長如一個騎行場，給牛和羊用。

segments.orig:
hathra âpem frâtat-cayat
hâthrô-masanghem adhwanem
hathra marekhå avastayat avi mat zairi-gaonem mat hvairyeite
ajyamnem,
hathra nmânå avastayat katemca fraskembemca fravâremca
pairi-vâremca.
segments.en:
There he made waters flow in a bed
a hathra long; there he settled birds, on the green
that never fades, with food that never fails. There
he established dwelling-places, consisting of a house
with a balcony, a courtyard, and a gallery.
segments.zh: 他在那裡引來了一條長如一哈特拉的水渠流經；他在那永不凋萎的青草地上安置了鳥類，食物永不短缺。他在那裡建立了住所，由帶陽台的房舍、庭院和走廊組成。

segments.orig:
hathra vîspanãm narãm nâirinãmca
taoxma upa-barat ýôi heñti ainghå zemô
mazishtaca vahishtaca sraêshtaca, hathra vîspanãm
gêush saredhanãm taoxma upa-barat ýôi
heñti ainghå zemô mazishtaca vahishtaca sraêshtaca.
segments.en:
There he brought the seeds of men and women, of the greatest,
best, and finest on this earth; there he brought the seeds of
every kind of cattle, of the greatest, best, and finest on this
earth.
segments.zh: 他帶去了男性和女性種子，此世上最偉大、最善良、最美麗的人類種子；他帶去了各種牲畜的種子，此世上最偉大、最善良、最美麗的牲畜種子。

segments.orig:
hathra vîspanãm urvaranãm taoxma upa-barat
ýôi heñti ainghå zemô barezishtaca
hubaoidhitemaca, hathra vîspanãm hvarethanãm
taoxma upa-barat ýôi heñti ainghå zemô
hvarezishtaca hubaoidhitemaca, tê kerenaot mithwaire ajyamnem
vîspem â ahmât ýat aête narô
varefshva anghen.
segments.en:
There he brought the seeds of every kind of tree, of the highest
of size and sweetest of odour on this earth; there he brought
the seeds of every kind of fruit, the best of savour and sweetest
of odour. All those seeds he brought, two of every kind, to be
kept inexhaustible there, so long as those men shall stay in the
Vara.
segments.zh: 他帶去了各種樹木的種子，此世上體型最高、香氣最甘美的樹木種子；他帶去了各種果實的種子，此世上味道最佳、香氣最甘美的果實種子。他帶去了這一切種子，每種兩份，使其在瓦雷納中永不耗盡，只要那些人留在瓦雷納中。

segments.orig:
nôit athra frakavô nôit apakavô nôit
apâvayô nôit haredhish nôit driwish nôit
daiwish nôit kasvîsh nôit vîzbârish
nôit vîmîtô-dañtânô
nôit paêsô ýô vîteretô-tanush
naêdha-cim anyãm daxshtanãm ýôi
heñti angrahe mainyêush daxshtem mashyâishca
paiti nidhâtem.
segments.en:
And there were no humpbacked, none bulged forward there; no
impotent, no lunatic; no one malicious, no liar; no one spiteful,
none jealous; no one with decayed tooth, no leprous to be pent
up, nor any of the brands wherewith Angra Mainyu stamps the bodies
of mortals.
segments.zh: 在那裡沒有駝背的人，沒有向前凸起的人；沒有陽痿的人，沒有瘋癲的人；沒有惡意的人，沒有說謊者；沒有心懷怨恨的人，沒有嫉妒的人；沒有牙齒腐爛的人，沒有該囚禁的癩病患者，也沒有任何安格拉‧曼紐用來烙印凡人身體的印記。

segments.orig:
fratemem dainghêush nava perethwô kerenaot madhemô
xshvash nitemô tishrô fratemem perethwô hazangrem
narãm nâirinãmca taoxma upa-barat madhemô
xshvash sata nitemô tishrô sata, aiwica hô varefshva
suwrya zaranaênya
apica hô varem marezat dvarem raocanem hvâraoxshnem
añtare-naêmât.
segments.en:
In the largest part of the place he made nine streets, six
in the middle part, three in the smallest. To the streets of the
largest part he brought a thousand seeds of men and women; to
the streets of the middle part, six hundred; to the streets of
the smallest part, three hundred. That Vara he sealed up with
the golden ring, and he made a door, and a window self-shining
within.
segments.zh: 在最寬闊的部分他開闢了九條街道，中等部分六條，最狹窄部分三條。在最寬闊部分的街道上他帶去了一千份男性和女性種子；在中等部分的街道上六百份；在最狹窄部分的街道上三百份。他用金環封閉了那個瓦雷納，製造了一道門和一扇自身閃耀的窗子在內部。

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
cayô âat aête raocå anghen ashâum
ahura mazda ýô avatha â-raocayeite aêtaêshva
varefshva ýô ýimô kerenaot.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What are the
lights that give light in the Vara which Yima made?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！伊瑪所造之瓦拉中，何者乃光？

segments.orig:
âat aoxta ahurô mazdå, hvadhâtaca
raocå stidhâtaca, hakeret zî irixtahe sadhayaca
vaênaite starasca måsca hvareca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'There are
uncreated lights and created lights. The one
thing missed there is the sight of the stars,
the moon, and the sun, and a year seems only as a day.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『有未造之光，亦有已造之光。其中唯一所缺者，乃星辰、月亮與太陽之光景，且一年之光似如一日。』

segments.orig:
taêca ayare mainyeñte ýat ýâre,
cathwaresatem aiwi-gâmanãm dvaêibya haca nerebya
dva nara us-zayeiñte mithwana strica nairyasca atha aêtaêshãm
ýôi gêush saredhanãm, taêca narô
sraêshta gaya jvaiñti aêtaêshva varefshva
ýô ýimô kerenaot.
segments.en:
'Every fortieth year, to every couple
two are born, a male and a female. And thus it
is for every sort of cattle. And the men in the
Vara which Yima made live the happiest life.'
segments.zh: 『每四十年，每對夫婦生二人，一男一女。一切家畜亦然。伊瑪所造之瓦拉中之人，因此過最幸福之生活。』

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum,
kô avatha daênãm mâzdayasnîm vî-barat
aêtaêshva varefshva ýô ýimô
kerenaot, âat aoxta ahurô mazdå, vîsh
karshipta spitama zarathushtra.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Who is he who
brought the Religion of Mazda into the Vara which Yima made? Ahura
Mazda answered: 'It was the bird Karshipta, O holy Zarathushtra!'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！誰將馬茲達之教帶入伊瑪所造之瓦拉中？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『乃鳥喀爾希普塔，聖查拉圖斯特拉啊！』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum, kô aêshãm
asti anghuca ratushca, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
urvatat-narô zarathushtra tûmca ýô zarathushtrô!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Who are the
Lord and the Master there? Ahura Mazda answered: 'Urvatat-nara,
O Zarathushtra! and thyself, Zarathushtra.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！其中之主及師者為誰？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『烏爾瓦塔特‧納拉，查拉圖斯特拉啊！及爾自身，查拉圖斯特拉。』
